title: Customer Profile — sales context v1 request (CANDIDATE v1-rc1)
description: JSON body of POST /v1/capabilities/customer/sales-context (CP-J4-F2). Read-only, no transactional effect; the response carries Cache-Control: no-store. Identifiers travel ONLY in this body: no path parameter and no query string (any query is 400 unsupported_query_params). purpose is mandatory and selects the composition of the answer. Unknown properties are 400. The body is limited to 1 KiB (413 request_too_large); Content-Type must be application/json (415).

page.description: Explicit maximum for this J4 purpose: at most 10 items per page and offset 0–40 (a 50-item window).
